notes: Three builds in one update. New: Priority cast, a tick box that casts a skill the moment its cooldown ends, measured about 8 percent faster. New: Life Bond now protects the nearest party member or a named ally you choose, saved per character. New: Auto-store destination, Storage or Guild Storage. New: low HP triggers for Aegis of Light and High Guard, with High Guard switching itself back off once you have healed. Fixed: Taunt with Cast on every cooldown now casts without an enemy nearby, which it never could before. Changed: Auto Rapid aims at your combat target, turning Auto Sell or Auto Store off mid trip no longer tears the trip down, casting is quicker on Priority cast skills, and the app now uses one set of colours and controls across every page.
